Container.Name: 4ga Boards
Container.Overview: 4ga Boards(https://4gaboards.com) is an straightforward realtime kanban boards management for intuitive task tracking.

Config.Name: BASE_URL
Config.Description: The URL you will use to access 4ga Boards including protocol, and port if not 80/443.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Postgres database URL. Special characters must be url encoded(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Percent-encoding).

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Session encryption key, recommended 64 character alphanumeric.

Config.Name: DEFAULT_ADMIN_USERNAME
Config.Description: Default admin username (applied only on first run).

Config.Name: DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAIL
Config.Description: Default admin email (applied only on first run).

Config.Name: DEFAULT_ADMIN_NAME
Config.Description: Default admin name (applied only on first run).

Config.Name: DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Default admin password (applied only on first run).

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Set to `1` to trust upstream proxies if reverse proxying.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Local path for 4ga Boards data files.
